item.title: PM’s Disaster Relief Fund balance stands at Rs 14.02 billion

item.title: Economic Digest: A Snapshot of Nepal’s Business News
item.dc:creator: Khabarhub
item.description: KATHMANDU: Economic Digest presents a brief yet comprehensive roundup of major business developments in Nepal, delivered in clear and accessible summaries. Nepal’s economic landscape on Monday reflected a mix of market optimism, external pressures and the mounting costs of natural disasters. The Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) gained 25.55 points to 2,585.04, extending double-digit gains for a second consecutive session. item.title: Bhojpur farmers turn to turmeric farming as monkeys damage crops
item.dc:creator: Khabarhub
item.description: BHOJPUR: Farmers in Bhojpur have started turning to turmeric cultivation as an alternative after monkeys repeatedly damaged their crops. With corn, millet, rice, fruits, and other crops increasingly being destroyed by monkeys, local farmers have begun cultivating turmeric, which is less vulnerable to the animals.
